Both countries apply GST, customs duty a: Both countries apply GST, customs duty and biosecurity rules to imported parcels, but the details differ. Australia administers import rules through the Australian Border Force and the Australian Taxation Office, with biosecurity conditions from the Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Forestry. New Zealand administers its rules through New Zealand Customs and Inland Revenue, with biosecurity conditions from the Ministry for Primary Industries.
On the Australian side, goods with a cus: On the Australian side, goods with a customs value up to AUD 1,000 are generally not charged duty, GST or import charges at the border (alcohol and tobacco excepted), but GST on the sale can still apply at checkout under the ATO's low-value imported goods rules for non-resident sellers. Above AUD 1,000, an import declaration is required. On the New Zealand side, goods with a value up to NZ$1,000 are generally not charged duty or GST at the border, while under Inland Revenue rules GST of 15% applies at checkout when an overseas seller's taxable turnover from New Zealand sales reaches NZ$60,000 in a 12-month period. Above NZ$1,000, goods are charged at the border and a Customs Number is required.
What a shopper ultimately pays, and whet: What a shopper ultimately pays, and whether a product is permitted, depends on the parcel's value, the product classification and the ingredients or materials involved. The checklist below is a suggested inves: The checklist below is a suggested investigation method, not a Shopify-prescribed discrepancy resolution procedure.
The action used to process a transfer af: The action used to process a transfer affects how Shopify records inventory. Compare that action with dispatch records and physical receiving evidence.
Draft: inventory is not committed. Locat: Draft: inventory is not committed. Locations, products and quantities can still be edited.
Mark as ready to ship: inventory is comm: Mark as ready to ship: inventory is committed at the origin location.
Move to in transit: the transfer changes: Move to in transit: the transfer changes to In progress, inventory is marked as incoming at the destination, and a shipment is automatically created.
Mark as transferred: a shipment is autom: Mark as transferred: a shipment is automatically created and received, and inventory is made available at the destination.
Transferred status: Shopify records the: Transferred status: Shopify records the transfer as complete, with all items received and available at the destination.
Shopify describes Mark as transferred as: Shopify describes Mark as transferred as the action to use when items have already been physically moved. Because this action automatically receives inventory, a completed transfer record is not independent evidence that someone counted the goods.
If the recorded receipt differs from the: If the recorded receipt differs from the warehouse count, retain both records and establish which action was taken. Do not mark a transfer complete or adjust inventory simply to make the totals agree.
Create a comparison worksheet with one r: Create a comparison worksheet with one row per affected variant and shipment. Keep the transfer total separate so it is not counted again for each shipment.
Check whether a transfer CSV was importe: Check whether a transfer CSV was imported. When an import into an existing transfer includes variants already on that transfer, Shopify overwrites those variants' existing quantities with the imported quantities. This does not mean every quantity on the transfer is overwritten.
Check that the receiving evidence refers: Check that the receiving evidence refers to the destination recorded on the transfer. After a transfer has been processed, Shopify does not allow its origin or destination to be changed, although other details can be edited. If a location is wrong, seek guidance on the appropriate correction rather than assuming it can be edited.
Transferring inventory to a location rec: Transferring inventory to a location records quantity there but does not itself activate the product at that location. Products can be stocked as the transfer is received or activated separately.
Keep an availability question separate f: Keep an availability question separate from a quantity question. Goods being physically present but not sellable or fulfilable at the destination is a different issue from a physical count that does not match the receipt.
Ask the sending and receiving teams to c: Ask the sending and receiving teams to compare their records against the same shipment IDs and product variants. Give them a concise evidence pack rather than an unexplained inventory total.
Include the transfer reference, affected: Include the transfer reference, affected variants, shipment IDs, tracking details, dispatch records, receiving evidence and the quantities still in dispute. State what is known and what still needs checking.

A Shopify order can be paid while its fu: A Shopify order can be paid while its fulfilment remains on hold. Payment status alone does not explain why the hold exists or show that the underlying issue has been resolved.

Do not use a list filter or the order's: Do not use a list filter or the order's headline status as the only evidence that no holds remain.
A fulfilment can have several holds at t: A fulfilment can have several holds at the same time. For example, a manual inventory hold and an app-applied system hold can affect the same fulfilment. Shopify permits up to 10 manual holds per fulfilment.
Record each displayed reason and identif: Record each displayed reason and identify whether a person, Flow workflow, app or service placed it where that information is available. Mark missing details as unknown rather than guessing.

Shopify's timing descriptions are specif: Shopify's timing descriptions are specific to particular hold types, not a universal release deadline. Elapsed time alone is not evidence that an issue is resolved or permission to override a hold.

Pending upsell offer: a post-purchase up: Pending upsell offer: a post-purchase upsell app can place the order on hold while the customer considers an offer. Check the relevant app and offer status.
Unknown delivery date: a selling plan re: Unknown delivery date: a selling plan requiring future fulfilment at an unscheduled date can trigger a hold, usually for pre-orders. Check the selling plan and the unresolved fulfilment date.

When multiple holds exist, Shopify allow: When multiple holds exist, Shopify allows you to select which holds to release. Limit any authorised change to the holds whose release is justified.

An unexpected assignment does not, by it: An unexpected assignment does not, by itself, show that stock records are wrong. Start by checking the routing setup rather than changing inventory quantities to influence which warehouse receives the order.

Shopify order routing requires two or mo: Shopify order routing requires two or more active locations. Review which locations are active, then inspect the rules your store actually uses. Do not assume the default configuration is still in place.

Shopify also describes advanced prioriti: Shopify also describes advanced prioritisation using location metafields, such as warehouse capacity or fulfilment speed. If your rules use these fields, review the values and how they relate to the configured priorities.

A Shopify basket can split into multiple: A Shopify basket can split into multiple shipments when its items cannot be fulfilled in one shipment. Separate products held at different locations are one reason. Different shipping profiles, preorders, subscriptions and Buy with Prime products can also cause a split.
The shipping charge depends on more than: The shipping charge depends on more than the number of shipments. Location groups, shipping profiles, rate types and the customer's selected shipping options can affect the total. Two shipments do not automatically mean two additive charges.
Start by recording what checkout shows,: Start by recording what checkout shows, then compare it with the applicable settings. An unexpected total is a reason to investigate, not proof that Shopify has charged incorrectly.
Before changing anything, establish whet: Before changing anything, establish whether your store uses shipping options by market. Shopify documents different charge behaviour for this setup.
For stores upgraded to shipping options: For stores upgraded to shipping options by market, split shipping is activated and the setting to activate or deactivate it no longer applies. Do not look for the older control as a universal solution.
Where the setting still applies, Shopify: Where the setting still applies, Shopify places it under Settings > Shipping and delivery. The entry point below the shipping profile list is split shipping or Manage, depending on whether fulfillable inventory settings are present. Check the setup before deciding whether a display change is relevant.
Under shipping options by market, rates: Under shipping options by market, rates are added when customers choose different shipping options for different shipments, when shipments use app-provided rates, or when the order combines preorders with items shipping immediately. The preorder exception applies even when the rates belong to the same shipping option.
A method available for only some shipmen: A method available for only some shipments can remain available through More shipping options. Selecting it can add its price to the charges for other shipments. Compare the selected methods, not just their names in the store settings.
Different locations within the same loca: Different locations within the same location group: in Shopify's flat-rate example, a single flat-rate charge covers the split order. This is not a rule for every rate type. Check that the locations belong to the same group and that the example matches your rate setup.
Different location groups or shipping pr: Different location groups or shipping profiles: Shopify's example adds the shipping charges together. Customers can use More shipping options to select different available methods for individual shipments. Check each product's profile and the relevant location groups.
Shipping options by market: when multipl: Shipping options by market: when multiple shipments use flat rates or order-amount rates under the same shipping option, the customer pays once at the highest matching rate. Other shipments covered by that option are labelled Included.
Use a controlled test basket to make the: Use a controlled test basket to make the result repeatable. The checklist below is a suggested investigation method, not a Shopify-required procedure. Keep customer names, contact details and full addresses out of shared notes.
Customers can choose available shipping: Customers can choose available shipping methods where checkout offers them, but they cannot choose how products are divided into shipments. If products that could ship together are being split, review shipping profiles and location fulfilment settings before making an authorised change.
Split shipping does not support dividing: Split shipping does not support dividing multiples of the same line item across locations to meet the requested quantity. Do not assume that enough stock across several locations means checkout can split that quantity between them.
Shopify also lists limitations for draft: Shopify also lists limitations for draft-order checkouts with an existing shipping line and B2B checkouts that require orders to be placed as drafts. With local delivery activated, checkout does not display multiple shipments.
Some third-party fulfilment apps might n: Some third-party fulfilment apps might not be compatible. Test eligible items in storefront checkout and ask the app developer where compatibility is uncertain. Shopify's documentation does not establish compatibility for every warehouse connection, including a particular Vareya or ShipHero configuration.
Before changing settings, write down the: Before changing settings, write down the expected result and who owns the change. Retest the same basket, destination and selected methods afterwards. Record both the shipment grouping and the total charge.
Check whether the observed total follows: Check whether the observed total follows the applicable charge pattern. If it remains unexplained, send the investigation record to the store administrator or relevant app developer rather than making several unrelated changes at once.
Do not treat hiding the split-shipping d: Do not treat hiding the split-shipping display as proof that physical shipments have been combined or shipping costs removed. A display setting, checkout charge and warehouse shipping plan are separate things to verify.
A checkout-charge investigation and a fu: A checkout-charge investigation and a fulfilment-provider assessment answer different questions. A fit enquiry should explain the intended stock locations, product mix, destination markets and shipping requirements; it should not assume that changing provider will resolve the checkout behaviour.

Order volume sets the baseline: how many: Order volume sets the baseline: how many orders pass through the warehouse each month, and how concentrated they are. Volume influences storage planning, staffing and the commercial terms a provider can offer.
